## 2. What to build

**§10 Presence, statuses and Focus** (prototype frames 4, 8)
- **Focusing:** teammates see "Focusing" (plus "until 3:00 PM" only during a Pomodoro phase or a counted-down estimate, CH42); the task's title only if you turn on "Show what I'm focusing on" and they can see that task (CH47). Focus holds chat's pings until the session ends, then they arrive together: "3 messages while you focused".
- **Statuses** (CH28d, CH45): an emoji + short text + "clear after" (30 min · 1 h · today · this week · a date · never) + optionally "do not disturb while it's on"; Moduo's presets In a meeting · Out sick · On vacation · Commuting, and your own saved ones ("Sleeping until 6"); **one status for all your workspaces**; set from your avatar in the top bar. It shows in the direct message's header, on a line above the box ("Jana is on vacation until Oct 20. She won't be notified; your message waits in her Catch up"), the person card and Details' people; Chat adds it to the shared person picker, so Tasks' assign picker shows "Jana · on vacation until Oct 20" (BUILD_ORDER 🟠 box). During your quiet hours, teammates who message you see "Sofia's quiet hours · back 9:00" on the same line above the box (CH7).

**§15 Settings, and where each thing lives**
- **Settings → Notifications:** the Chat switches of the table (direct messages, mentions and replies, announcements, Every message, each key's notifications) · "Show message text" · Sound · "Email when away" · Browser notifications (the permission's state, "Not allowed by the browser") · **Quiet hours** (one switch and a range, in your Time & region zone; off by default; holds every module's notices).
- **The workspace switcher:** "Pause notifications from this workspace".

**§11 table rows**
| Event | Who hears | When | OS / browser | Bell | Catch up | Count | Email after 1 h away | Turned off by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Focus ends with held pings | You | When the run ends | One summary: "3 messages while you focused" | No | — | — | No | — |
| Quiet hours, do not disturb or a vacation end | Nobody | — | No | No | Everything that arrived waits (CH41); it never emails (CH74) | — | No | — |

**Edge cases this block handles** (§Edge cases)
- Quiet hours, do not disturb or a vacation end → nothing pings; what arrived waits in Catch up; no email goes out for it.
- A Focus session ends with held pings → one summary notice; the items are in Catch up.
- A person in two workspaces with chat → statuses, quiet hours and do not disturb apply to both; the switcher counts each; the dock badge is the sum.

## 3. Acceptance criteria

**AC7 — Catch up and notifications**
- **AC7.5** quiet hours, do not disturb, a vacation, a paused workspace and Focus hold device notices and emails while the bell and Catch up fill

**AC3 — A duo's week**
- **AC3.5** quiet hours 19:00–9:00 in their zone hold every notice and nothing pings at 9:00

**AC6 — An agency's week (internal chat)**
- **AC6.4** the client's workspace notifications pause from the switcher while the agency's own keep ringing

**AC11 — Presence, statuses and Focus**
- **AC11.5** Focus holds pings and ends with one summary

**Tests that prove them** (file · name · AC · plain English)

- `supabase/tests/chat_notices.test.sql` · "holds and the gate" · proves AC7.5, AC3.5, AC6.4, AC11.5 · Quiet hours, do not disturb, a vacation, a paused workspace drop the device notice and keep the bell and item; Focus holds and the end writes one summary; a reminder push is held by quiet hours too.
- `supabase/tests/chat_notices.test.sql` · "the email after an hour" · proves AC3.2, AC7.9 · One `chat_waiting` email per person, conversation and hour; none within the hour of a client seen; none for something that arrived during quiet hours; the text only under "Show message text".
- `src/lib/time-region.test.ts` · "quiet hours in the one store" · proves AC3.5, AC7.5 · Quiet hours save through the Time & region op, follow the person's zone, cross midnight, and the gate reads them for every kind.

## 4. Decisions that bind it

- **Quiet hours** (round-3 §2.10, #21; CH7, CH41): `user_preferences.quiet_hours_on boolean not null default false`, `quiet_from time`, `quiet_to time` (the range may cross midnight), saved through **`user_op_set_time_region`** (key `quiet_hours` = `{on, from, to}`), read through `user_time_region`; redefine both and the guard `user_preferences__time_region_guard` (columns op-only, like the zone) from their **live bodies** (TV-D14, `20261013200000_user_preferences_time_region.sql`). Helper `time_region__quiet_now(user, at) → (quiet, back_at)` in the person's `time_zone` (UTC when unknown). Settings → Notifications shows one switch and a range; it serves **every module's** notices, Tasks' reminder pushes included (the reminder still lands in the bell).
- **Pausing** (§2.12, CH46): `workspace_members.notices_paused_at`, written only by `workspace_op_pause_notices(ws, paused)` on the caller's own row; "Pause notifications from this workspace" in the workspace switcher (`src/components/workspace-switcher.tsx`); a paused workspace sends no OS, browser or email notice while its bell, Catch up and counts keep filling.
- **The gate** (§2.14 f): give CV-6a's `notice__gate(user, ws, kind, at)` its rules: **drop** when the workspace is paused, in quiet hours, or the person has a do-not-disturb status (by hand, sick, vacation); **hold** chat kinds during a Focus run in any workspace (row written with `held_for_focus`, never pushed); otherwise send. A `BEFORE INSERT` trigger on `notice_deliveries` applies *drop* to every kind, so TV-D12's reminder sender needs no change; a short list of kinds that break through stays empty for Chat. "Drop" only skips the device notice: the bell row and Catch up item are always written, so everything waits in Catch up and nothing pings when quiet hours, a vacation or Focus end (CH41).
- **`held_at`** (CH74): a Catch up item written while the gate answered *drop* is stamped `held_at`; CV-6a's email job (`chat__queue_waiting_emails`, redefine it here) never emails it, nor anything while paused, in quiet hours or on do not disturb at that moment.
- **Focus ends** (trigger on `focus_runs` leaving `running`): that person's held rows close and one `chat_focus_summary` row is written through the gate: "3 messages while you focused" (and "3 held until Focus ends", #33). `chat_now` (CV-17) is redefined with `quiet_now` / `back_at` for the line "Sofia's quiet hours · back 9:00" above the box.

## 7. Watch out

- Round-3 §5 risks 2 and 8: `user_op_set_time_region`, `user_time_region` and the guard are shared with Settings; a dropped or held ping is a missed ping by design. The trigger on `notice_deliveries` also gates Tasks' reminders: keep Tasks' tests green and prove a reminder still pushes outside quiet hours.
- **Tier 2** (migrations, RLS, contracts, moduo-mcp, src/lib/runtime*): one `/code-review high` and one security scan of the diff at the end; scan findings go only into the hand-back.
- **Migration:** stamp provisional (re-cut on apply day, chat's order kept); redefine from live bodies (`pg_get_functiondef`); re-state grants by name (`DROP` + `CREATE` resets them); re-assert the Realtime publication if you publish a table; apply only on your migration turn, then `bun run db:test chat`; never `local:reset` or `migration up` (runbook, `docs/gotchas/supabase.md`).
- **Public repo:** describe no security weakness in any file; tell the orchestrator in the hand-back.

## 8. Out of scope for this block

The statuses and presence themselves (CV-17); the Focus engine (Tasks'); device clients (CV-6b); the email job's first version (CV-6a).
